svg.aria-label: S12 Dispatch, five buffers, entry by entry
svg.text: S12 Dispatch, five buffers, entry by entry

Each buffer is a column of slots the player fills. Eight micro-ops come in a cycle, and one a cycle goes into each scheduler queue. The in-order hold keeps a younger micro-op behind an older one. Empty slots mean nothing else is in flight.
2 integer buffers, one multiply, one load-store, one FP
a stuck older entry holds the younger
a buffer empties in program order
KB: dispatch.int_buffers, dispatch.int_entries, dispatch.mul_entries, dispatch.ls_entries, dispatch.fp_entries, dispatch.accept_width, dispatch.queue_inflow, dispatch_buffers
